title: How is Gaddafi connected to Clifford?
description: A 2009 summit photo, a White House welcome and an Easter Egg Roll connect Libya's Muammar Gaddafi to Clifford the Big Red Dog.
hook: How's Gaddafi linked to Clifford the Big Red Dog?

Muammar Gaddafi.label: Gaddafi

links.line: In 2009, Gaddafi stood beside Barack Obama at the G8 summit in Italy.
That year, on Inauguration Day, Obama walked Laura Bush to her farewell helicopter.

image.file: File:Clifford the Big Red Dog at the WhiteHouse Easter Egg Roll, 2007Apr09.jpg

links.line: And in 2007, Laura Bush posed with Clifford the Big Red Dog.
